name: @sunder/package-tool
description: Build tooling for thin runtime-backed Sunder TypeScript Worker V1 packages.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=2 dist-test/test/*.test.js
